subtitle: LIVING AZEROTH — Cinematic World & Interactive Studio Experience
changes: Introduced Living Azeroth, a fully illustrated original cinematic entrance and five interactive destinations with adaptive fantasy presentation.
Built a reusable v9 visual engine with original SVG citadel and oracle artwork, atmospheric particles, source-aware visuals, and Cinematic/Balanced/Performance modes.
Enhanced the original Talent Forge with visual node selection, glowing allocated paths and a read-only selected-node inspector fed from existing Blizzard-reported talent text and rank controls.
Introduced a Living Armory presentation with selectable equipment slots and detail cards sourced strictly from existing Blizzard public equipment responses.
Added an Adventure Journal navigation and chapter styling around the existing Mythic+, raid and reputations research without inventing achievement or inventory records.
Transformed ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant into an illustrated Oracle persona with guided-response states while retaining the existing curated knowledge and Mission Architect.
Added cinematic styling and a five-chamber navigator to Sovereign Ascension, improved desktop/mobile responsiveness, opt-in performance settings and reduced-motion respect.
Preserved the v8.0 rollback branch, legacy saved-data formats, Battle.net Cloudflare Worker, existing original studios, Founder bubble and HYPER MUSIC without changing their logic.
Synchronized Player Handbook, Getting Started, developer test requests, QA device acceptance, Gateway and release notes; guarded Discord release draft remains staging until acceptance.
